newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.33 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.33 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 364-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.33 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.16146 percent at 0330 GMT and an average accepted yield of 5.62 percent at the last monthly tender of one-year bills on October 1.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue fell to HK$2.56 billion from the previous HK$2.61 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.94 percent, against three-month HIBOR of 5.56771 percent and the average accepted yield of 5.19 percent at last week's tender of three-month bills.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue was down to HK$6.05 billion from HK$7.71 billion.
